text: The initiative has improved five climate products for PNG, created weekly, monthly, and seasonal drought monitoring products, and issued the first dynamic-model seasonal forecast to decision-makers. It engaged 115 users across agriculture, health, water, and disaster management sectors. The project funds totaled approximately US$1.65 million, with a leverage factor of 0.36x.

metadata.solution_name: Climate Risk and Early Warning Systems – Papua New Guinea Drought Early Warning System (CREWS‑PNG)
